identity.name: Sir Thalassos of the Sunken Maw

narrative.appearance: His plate armor is encrusted with salt and barnacles, weeping brine from every joint. A heavy cloak of kelp-woven silk clings to his shoulders like wet seaweed.
narrative.personality: He speaks with the crushing weight of the deep ocean, calm yet relentlessly inevitable. He views all life as a temporary bubble destined to pop beneath the waves.
narrative.background: Once a celebrated captain of the harbor guard, he survived a shipwreck by making a pact with the entity slumbering in the abyss.
narrative.goals: To ensure the rising tides reclaim the corrupt spires of the city to appease his master.
narrative.secret: He is slowly turning into salt and coral from the inside out.
narrative.rumor: They say if you press your ear to his breastplate, you can hear the crushing pressure of the deep sea.
narrative.party_hook: He offers the party passage through the treacherous reef if they can recover a lost relic from a sunken cathedral.
narrative.voice_style: A low, bubbling rasp that sounds like stones grinding under heavy currents.

world_integration.reputation: A grim sentinel of the docks, feared by smugglers and respected by the desperate.
world_integration.current_location: A salt-stained chapel built into the rotting pier of the lower docks.
world_integration.reaction_matrix: Hostile to those who pollute the harbor, indifferent to the law, and protective of the drowning.

attacks.name: Oathblade
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

attacks.name: Crushing Tide
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10.5 (1d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
